title: AuraDynamoDBSingleTableSchema
description: Single-table design entity mapping and key patterns for AuraCoreTable

attributes.preferences: object (adaptive notification, quiet hours, and briefing controls)

attributes.userId: string (non-blank; mandatory; set at issuance; never updated)
attributes.tenantId: string (non-blank; mandatory; set at issuance; never updated)
attributes.leaseOwnerId: string (UUID set when IN_PROGRESS; empty string otherwise)
attributes.leaseExpiresAt: number (epoch seconds; 0 when no active lease)
attributes.completedAt: number | null (epoch seconds; set upon SUCCEEDED)
attributes.failedReason: string | null (reason string set upon FAILED)
attributes.expires_at: number (epoch seconds; used for TTL-based rejection)
attributes.retry_count: number (atomically incremented on each FAILED transition)
attributes.required_reversals: list[string] (immutable list of required reversal steps e.g. ['device', 'slack'])
attributes.completed_reversals: list[string] (durably tracked list of completed reversal steps e.g. ['device', 'slack'])
attributes.uncertain_reversals: list[string] (durably tracked list of steps with ambiguous/timed-out remote outcomes requiring authoritative reconciliation)

notes: PK is unique per undo_token; one RECORD per token.
userId and tenantId must be stored non-blank at issuance; missing values are a data-integrity error and fail closed with 403.
tenant_default is a legitimate tenant value but must be written explicitly; a missing tenantId is never substituted with tenant_default at authorization time.
Status transitions: PENDING -> IN_PROGRESS -> SUCCEEDED (terminal) or FAILED (retriable). Atomic CAS on put_item prevents concurrent lease acquisition.
completedAt is set atomically upon terminal SUCCEEDED transition with condition #status = :in_progress AND leaseOwnerId = :owner.
failedReason is set and retry_count is atomically incremented (ADD retry_count :one) upon FAILED transition.
required_reversals locks required operations at issuance/lease-acquisition to prevent reversal scope from mutating between retries.
completed_reversals is updated atomically under leaseOwnerId fencing per completed step before proceeding to subsequent steps.
uncertain_reversals durably tracks timed-out or unconfirmed steps to block unauthoritative replays until authoritatively reconciled.
